thread:
Aisha (sec): Heads up — FinBank just finished their security review call. A few hard asks: 1) demonstrate service-account rotation and short-lived creds, 2) show KMS envelope key usage + rotation policy (they want HSM-backed), 3) exportable audit log proof for last 90 days, 4) evidence of RBAC change control and justification for granting SOC read-only to tenant logs. Can we triage?
Ravi (infra): Got it. I can draft the rotation docs and screenshots of our KMS integrations. For HSM: we support cloud KMS with external HSM via customer-managed keys — we'll need to show key import and rotation timestamps.
Tom (solutions): I was on the call — they also asked about service account vs short-lived OIDC tokens for workers. They prefer short-lived. We should show our STS flow and token TTLs.
Aisha (sec): Yes, short-lived tokens + automated rotation is the ask. Also they flagged a vuln in one third-party dependency (low severity) and asked for mitigation timeline.
Michelle (compliance): For the questionnaire, they want a canonical artifact bundle: KMS policy excerpt, key rotation schedule, export of audit logs (redacted), RBAC change PR + approval audit, and vuln ticket + remediation ETA.
Ravi (infra): Actionable checklist: 
- Export sample CloudAudit logs for tenant X (90d) with redaction markers
- Snapshot of KMS key metadata (algorithm, origin, purpose, rotation_ts)
- Demo script for STS token issuance and service-account rotation
- PR link showing RBAC role change + who approved it
- Link to vuln triage ticket + backport/patch plan
I'll start on logs & KMS metadata.
Aisha (sec): Ravi — can you run this command to grab a log sample and drop to secure share?
sec-bot: ```bash
# example query for CloudAudit logs
gcloud logging read 'resource.type=gce_instance AND protoPayload.serviceName="compute.googleapis.com"' --limit 50 --format json > audit_sample.json
```
Ravi (infra): Yep running now. Will redact tenant ids and PII before uploading.
Tom (solutions): For STS demo, use this snippet in the docs: 
```
# request short-lived token
POST /v1/assume-role
{ "service_account": "svc-redwood-llm", "ttl": "15m" }
```
and show the token expiry in response.
Michelle (compliance): On RBAC change control: attach the PR and link to Jira ID — they want timestamps and approver usernames. Make sure we include the deployment audit from CI system.
Aisha (sec): Also they want proof that audit logs are immutable for 90d. We can show retention policy + object checksum audit. Ravi can you grab the retention policy screenshot from storage console and the checksum logs?
Ravi (infra): I can. For checksum proof we have md5/sha256 metadata on exported objects. Will bundle that.
Aisha (sec): On the vuln: can someone paste the triage note? I remember it was a GH advisory with patch available.
Tom (solutions): Triage note: CVE-2025-3341 in libproto — severity: Low. Affects optional dep used in pre-processing pipeline. Mitigation: upgrade to v2.1.3, backported to stable branch, tests passing in staging. ETA: 3 business days to fully deploy to prod.
Michelle (compliance): Put the ETA and proof of test run logs into the evidence packet. They may ask for rollback plan too.
Aisha (sec): Good. Next: HSM-backed KMS — customer asked if we can provide attestation. We can supply KMS key metadata and cloud provider attestation doc. Ravi, can you collect provider attestation links?
Ravi (infra): Yes — I'll grab CloudKMS attestation doc and our key import logs (timestamps).
sec-bot: Policy change applied: rbac/allow-soc-readonly.yaml -> staged (deployer: ci-bot)
Tom (solutions): Small note — the SOC read-only role exposes tenant log metadata but not customer content. Document that explicitly. They asked about least-privilege justification.
Aisha (sec): I'll draft the justification text and link the PR. Also recommend we schedule a follow-up with FinBank in 48 hours to walk through the artifact package.
Michelle (compliance): I'll assemble the questionnaire responses in the standard template. Tagging owners: Ravi (logs/kms), Tom (STS/service accounts), Aisha (RBAC/vuln summary).
Ravi (infra): Upload ETA: logs export + KMS metadata by EOD today to the secure share.
Tom (solutions): I'll produce STS demo and token TTL screenshots by tomorrow morning.
Aisha (sec): I'll prepare RBAC change history and approver evidence by EOD.
Michelle (compliance): I'll start the evidence zip and put placeholders for items pending.
Aisha (sec): Anyone see any blockers?
Tom (solutions): Only potential blocker is scheduling access to FinBank tenant for a final log validation, but they seemed okay with us providing redacted samples.
Ravi (infra): No other blockers. Running the log query now.
sec-bot: export uploaded to secure-share/redwood-finbank/2230123456/audit_sample_redacted.json
Aisha (sec): Thanks — I'll review the sample and then we'll send the package. Let's meet 24h after package sent for any clarifications. :thumbsup:
Michelle (compliance): Marking owner tasks in the questionnaire doc.
Tom (solutions): Noted. I'll also include a short architecture diagram showing where STS and KMS live.
Aisha (sec): Perfect. Closing loop here — follow-ups in the doc. :lock:
